Guidance & outlook: Expansion of the Australian Continued scale-up of Southern Emulsifiers Solutions Pty Ltd toward its three-year cumulative revenue target of approximately ₹75 crore, with two additional target customers expected to contribute from FY27.

Capacity has scaled in successive steps - from roughly 2,400 MTPA to 4,800 MTPA in FY24, to 7,800 MTPA in FY25, and to 12,000 MTPA in FY26 - achieved through incremental reactor additions at Lote Parshuram rather than greenfield investment, keeping capital intensity per tonne comparatively contained.
The subsidiary's medium-term target, first communicated in June 2025, remains a cumulative revenue contribution of approximately ?75 crore across the three-year period from FY26 to FY28.
Growth & demand: This momentum was already visible at the half-year mark: for H1 FY26, the Company reported revenue growth of 55%, PBT growth of 58%, and PAT growth of 63% over H2 FY26, which management attributed to operational efficiency, disciplined execution, and continued focus on high-margin specialty segments.

The food emulsifiers sub-segment alone is estimated at approximately USD 3.9-4.5 billion in 2026 by most research houses, growing at a CAGR of approximately 5-8% through the early 2030s, driven by processed and convenience food demand, clean-label reformulation, and growth in bakery, dairy and confectionery applications.

EBITDA grew 24.22% to ^26.15 crore, though EBITDA margin moderated to approximately 16.4% from an implied approximately 20.7% in FY25, reflecting deliberate volume-led growth, geographic expansion, and customer-base broadening during the year.
Margins & costs: Southern Emulsifiers is targeted to generate approximately ₹75 crore in revenue over three years, with gross margins expected in the 10-15% range and annual improvement of 200-300 basis points through product optimisation and operating leverage.

Management has indicated that, assuming stable macroeconomic and raw material price conditions, it expects gradual, quarter-on-quarter improvement in EBITDA margin as procurement scale benefits and stronger supplier terms materialise.

Capex & expansion: Revenue from operations grew 57.93% to ₹159.87 crore, and the Company advanced construction of its Greenfield manufacturing facility on plot C3, expected to be operational by the end of FY27, alongside continued investment in a new quality control and R&D facility and infrastructure for a certified food-grade emulsifier range.
The Company also deepened its international presence through its subsidiaries in Australia and the USA, and completed a rights issue of ₹48.88 crore in November 2025 to fund capacity expansion.
